question: What is released from that, and what true form does it take?
premises: it is released from that and set outside
it is released again in just the same way
the true form of the good ones is the threefold power itself
inference: what is let go takes its true form as the threefold power
uncertainties: tattasmādbahirvātha segmentation uncertain between tat, tasmāt, bahiḥ, vā and atha
plain_english: What is released from that, and set outside, is released once more; thus their true form is the self of the threefold power.
